items.summary: Legal/compliance disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; human counsel required. Keep the private gate unchanged. Evidence: Woot documents API access, but current public terms do not establish rights for commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, or advertising. Technical compliance is only a baseline (36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown), security/accuracy/measurement gates remain incomplete, and revenue attribution is partial aggregate. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only if it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Do not send permission outreach without counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task may close because field-level rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent and do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or launch state.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price terms, and affiliate or advertising rights. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Both are scaffold/parked, analytics is not configured, and compliance reachability is unknown due to network failures; audience, disclosures, consent, monetization, and operational health are not evidenced. Exact decision: no launch or monetization change. Next evidence action: attach dated execution-owner verification, reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision evidence.
